units.source_text: 按察大纳言看了不胜妒羡，希望自己能交这等鸿运才好。

en.t: The Azechi Grand Counselor saw this and was overcome with envy, wishing that such good fortune might come his own way.

units.source_text: 这是因为：他从前曾经倾心恋慕二公主的母亲藤壶女御。

en.t: This was because he had once been deeply in love with the Second Princess's mother, the Fujitsubo Consort.

units.source_text: 女御入宫之后，犹不断念，常常送情书去。

en.t: Even after the Consort entered the palace, he still could not give up his feelings and often sent her love letters.

units.source_text: 最后又想娶得她所生的二公主，曾经托人向女御示意，要做二公主的保护人。

en.t: In the end, he even wanted to marry the Second Princess, whom she had borne, and once had someone hint to the Consort that he wished to become the princess's guardian.

units.source_text: 但女御终于不曾将此意转告皇上。

en.t: But the Consort never did pass this wish on to the Emperor.

units.source_text: 因此之故，按察大纳言心甚不快，他说：

en.t: For this reason, the Azechi Grand Counselor was deeply displeased, and he said:

units.source_text: “薰大将的人品果然佼佼不群，但今上在位之时，岂可如此隆重地优待一个女婿？

en.t: "General Kaoru is indeed a man of outstanding character, but while the present Emperor reigns, how can one son-in-law be treated with such extraordinary favor?

units.source_text: 九重之内，御座之旁，让一个臣下任意出入，

en.t: Within the innermost palace, beside the imperial seat, they allow a mere subject to come and go as he pleases,

units.source_text: 甚至举办飨宴，大张旗鼓地招待他，真是史无前例的啊！”

en.t: and even hold a banquet, receiving him with great ceremony. It is truly without precedent in history!"

units.source_text: 他愤愤不平，讥讽得很凶。

en.t: He was furious and resentful, and his sarcasm was especially sharp.

units.source_text: 然而总想看看这个宴会，所以也来出席，心中却在生气。

en.t: Yet he still wanted to see the banquet for himself, so he attended, though inwardly he remained angry.
